messages.label: PokemonTower_1F_Text_SpiritSearchingForFamily
messages.text:
.string "The tower carries the grief of\n"
    .string "families torn apart.\p"
    .string "Some say one spirit still waits\n"
    .string "above, calling for the family it\n"
    .string "lost.$"

messages.label: ViridianCity_Text_FatherHeardShadowyFigure
messages.text:
.string "My father once told me he\n"
    .string "ventured deep into VIRIDIAN\l"
    .string "FOREST.\p"
    .string "He heard the grumbling growls of\n"
    .string "a shadowy figure lurking within.$"

messages.label: SeafoamIslands_1F_Text_UsedToBeFloodedWithLava
messages.text:
.string "Can you believe this whole area\n"
	.string "used to be flooded with lava?\p"
	.string "One sudden change, and the\n"
	.string "whole cave became something else.$"

messages.label: DiglettsCave_NorthEntrance_RockTunnelPitchBlack
messages.text:
.string "This DIGLETT CAVE extends all\n"
    .string "the way to VERMILION CITY.\p"
    .string "Watch out for invisible walls\n"
    .string "though!\p"
    .string "Feels like something in there\n"
    .string "doesn't want visitors.$"

messages.label: Route2_Text_ForestComesAlive
messages.text:
.string "I'm too scared to enter\n"
    .string "VIRIDIAN FOREST.\p"
    .string "Legends tell of the forest\n"
    .string "coming alive and ensnaring the\l"
    .string "wicked, never to be seen again.$"

messages.label: Route4_Text_TrippedOverGeodude
messages.text:
.string "A hulking PRIMEAPE fled in a\n"
    .string "blind rage and took refuge\n"
    .string "inside MT. MOON.\p"
    .string "It was out of control, like its\n"
    .string "feelings had boiled over!\p"
    .string "I've never seen one get that\n"
    .string "big before!$"

messages.label: SaffronCity_Text_TookCuboneFromMother
messages.text:
.string "I took this CUBONE away from\n"
    .string "its mother.\p"
    .string "Now it won't even train with me!\n"
    .string "Bad investment.$"

messages.label: SaffronCity_Text_CuboneCry
messages.text: .string "CUBONE: Kyoo!$"

messages.label: LavenderTown_Text_VengefulSpiritAtopTower
messages.text:
.string "It's said that atop POKéMON\n"
    .string "TOWER is a vengeful spirit.\p"
    .string "It howls in anger over the\n"
    .string "family it lost.$"

messages.label: CinnabarVolcano_3F_Text_BlairPostBattle
messages.text:
.string "Fire-types love this pressure.\p"
    .string "Down here, even burned ground\n"
    .string "feels alive again.\p"
    .string "Like the volcano keeps renewing\n"
    .string "its own energy.$"

messages.label: CinnabarVolcano_3F_Text_BlairPostBattle

messages.label: CinnabarIsland_Text_ScientistsExperimentInMansion
messages.text:
.string "After each eruption, the volcano\n"
    .string "leaves new soil behind.\p"
    .string "Plants return stronger than before.\n"
    .string "Nature renews itself through fire.$"

messages.label: DiglettsCave_SouthEntrance_Text_DiglettDugThisTunnel
messages.text:
.string "Well, isn't this a surprise!\p"
    .string "MR. MIME have made themselves\n"
    .string "a little home together in\n"
    .string "DIGLETT CAVE.\p"
    .string "They seem intent on keeping it\n"
    .string "all to themselves.\p"
    .string "It leads all the way to PEWTER\n"
    .string "CITY, wouldn't you know!$"

messages.label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ResearchRoom_Text_MoltresRenewingEnergy
messages.text:
.string "Our lab studies how fire can\n"
    .string "restore as well as consume.\p"
    .string "There are reports of MOLTRES\n"
    .string "stirring life back into scorched\l"
    .string "volcanic earth.$"

messages.label: CeruleanCity_House2_Text_EnormousPokemonBargedIn
messages.text:
.string "An enormous POKéMON barged in\n"
    .string "through the wall!\p"
    .string "It was shaking with rage.\n"
    .string "Completely unstoppable!\p"
    .string "Lucky for us, it rampaged out\n"
    .string "the door and headed west.$"

messages.label: MtMoon_1F_Text_AngryPrimalPokemon
messages.text:
.string "There's something furious and\n"
    .string "hurt deep within this cave.\p"
    .string "I can feel it losing control.\n"
    .string "Maybe I should head home.$"

messages.label: Route20_Text_SeafoamUsedToBeVolcanic
messages.text:
.string "SEAFOAM ISLANDS used to be\n"
    .string "volcanic just like CINNABAR\l"
    .string "ISLAND.\p"
    .string "Then one day it all changed at\n"
    .string "once, and now it's as cold as\l"
    .string "ice!$"

messages.label: Route10_Text_MarkPostBattle
messages.text:
.string "When storms pass over the POWER\n"
    .string "PLANT, the river keeps buzzing.\p"
    .string "It's like nature is feeding it\n"
    .string "power without end.$"

    .string "CAVE and erected barriers.\p"
    .string "It's like they built their own\n"
    .string "little community and closed the\l"
    .string "world out.$"

messages.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_AROMA_LADY_NIKKI_Text_PostBattle
messages.text:
.string "The flowers in VIRIDIAN FOREST\n"
    .string "are so beautiful.\p"
    .string "They seem more vibrant and grow\n"
    .string "in number the closer you get to\l"
    .string "the centre of the forest.\p"
    .string "Almost like something is drawing\n"
    .string "them inward.$"
